evidence.note: Checked shard plan construction, pack write and rollback ordering: PlanShards runs before knowledge collection, packWriter.Write returns a rollback that is invoked on its own failure and again if the review/context write closure fails, joined via errors.Join so the original error is preserved.

Checked the post-success housekeeping guard: Prune always runs, GC only when result.Blocking is false, and result.Blocking is assigned inside the closure before it returns, so the guard reads the settled verdict.

Checked ingestShardResults: explicit --shard-result/--cross-shard-result paths are copied into a fresh slice before append, Discover is skipped only when both the plan and the explicit list are empty, and the manifest is built with the same scope/target record used for the run.
Checked that reviewMarkdown inserts the sharded section after the verdict token line so reviewlog still parses the first non-empty line under '## Verdict'.
Confirmed the new Options fields are actually wired to CLI flags for the task-done subcommand, so they are not dead configuration.
